mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.3% signals inflationary pressure that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) indicate stagflation, increasing equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% AND UNRATE > 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates late-cycle economic expansion where monetary policy tightening risks, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1300.0) signal strong consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals economic contraction and reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 500000.0) indicate robust consumer spending and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 500000.0

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS > 150000.0) signals tight labor markets and potential wage inflation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.0
